title: AIGC programming levels and practice exercises
summary: Learners complete contextualized programming levels and follow-up practical coding exercises in an AIGC platform. ChatGPT provides a personalized plan, learning partner, code processing, interaction, assessment, and feedback throughout the learning process.

sources.title: Research on the Construction of Intelligent Programming Platform Based on AI-generated Content
sources.evidence_quote: the learner needs to fully utilize the knowledge and skills of this learning process to pass the level

assessment.summary: Progress through generated programming-learning contexts, a final level, and practical exercises.
student_actions: Follow and refine a personalized learning plan.
Interact with the AIGC partner for guidance and code support.
Pass a final level and complete practical coding exercises.

outputs.artifact: Programming solutions and platform interaction records

student_role.description: GPT-3.5 generated content, code support, assessment, and feedback inside the platform.

provenance.extraction_method: Full PDF read from pdftotext output.

reported_results: Thirty-nine valid user questionnaires compared the platform with traditional learning and practice approaches.
